notes:
Original full primary paper obtained as HTML transcription; title/authors/DOI verified. Its OCR uses p for equals, ! for less than, and 1 for greater than; quoted OCR is retained verbatim. Replication is the author-hosted full published PDF. Original study 2 and replication section 7.1 are independently matched. Replication analytic N is the sum of printed condition ns, not the overall 1018 sample. No p value inferred from an F bound. Certainty Conditions interpreted as the main effect of certainty, not a simple effect conditional on an unspecified expertise level. Authors support competing confidence-heuristic hypothesis, but do not give an explicit replication-success verdict for this original null main effect; reported_success left null.
